digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface and agent tooling
propositions: rebar metrics command and registry exist but are not consulted by rebar-janitor during Discovery phase, limiting code-health evidence to one-shot tools

rebar metrics output (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events, source/confidence labels, unavailable state) is not documented in canonical project docs, making it undiscoverable to agents and contributors
rebar-janitor Discovery phase lacks guidance to run 'rebar metrics --since/--until --output json' and cite registered code-health-lens metric values as durable historical trend evidence
project documentation (AGENTS.md, user-guide.md) lacks a metrics entry point to point contributors and agents to the registry subsystem and command reference
